europe_now.title: Romanian Political Instability Deepens
europe_now.summary: Political turmoil in Romania escalated after parliament rejected the designated prime minister nominee. The legislative defeat further strains the country's governance amidst ongoing institutional challenges.

sources.headline: Romanian political crisis deepens as parliament rejects PM nominee

europe_now.title: Eurozone Inflation Exceeds Expectations
europe_now.summary: Economic pressures within the eurozone intensified as latest inflation figures outpaced previous forecasts. The faster-than-expected price increases present new challenges for monetary policymakers.

sources.headline: Eurozone inflation heats up faster than expected

top_stories.title: French School Protests
top_stories.summary: A wave of demonstrations across French schools resulted in numerous injuries and hundreds of arrests. Authorities continue to monitor the unrest as security forces respond to the widespread student protests.

sources.headline: Dozens hurt and hundreds arrested in wave of French school protests

top_stories.title: European Security and Software Policy
top_stories.summary: Multiple law enforcement agencies across Europe decided to drop a Russian software provider following an investigative report. The move highlights growing concerns regarding cybersecurity and foreign technology dependencies.

sources.headline: European police forces drop Russian software firm following POLITICO probe
